title: GS21 hump in a leverage index (b~ - 0.5 z~)^2, gs_bv -0.2, unbounded, gs_qcomp 1, gamma_v 2.5
question: Does the leverage-index hump reach room 30% and a fair gap of +0.029 with the bound removed or a higher price of y risk?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-05). The square in the leverage index L = b~ - k z~ (gvylqz1/5/5w) is the first leverage hump with room that holds across seeds: 18-22% (13-26% a seed), absolute 0.11-0.13 in Sharpe (gvyzzh10's 0.09), first fair gaps +0.076 / +0.060 (gvylqz5w). Doubling the loading at cap 4 (z5 -> z5w) did not raise the room, so the bound is suspected to switch the exposure off away from y = 0; and the price of y risk lifted the GS21 interaction from 27% to 37% (gvyslzh -> gvyslzg4). This economy: unbounded with the per-firm compensation (gs_qcomp 1).

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-11-05): room 30% or more and a fair gap at or above +0.029. FALSIFIED if room is at or below 10% on three seeds.
